tables.label: TABLE 1
tables.caption: dAMPs evaluated in support of RVVC treatment evaluation

tables.label: TABLE 2
tables.caption: MICs against fluconazole-resistant and sensitive Candida
footnotes: Clinical breakpoints taken from 2017 CLSI recommendations (37) and Pfaller and Diekema (42). Molecular weights are as follows: RP504, 2,455 amu; RP554, 1,884 amu; RP556, 2,157 amu; RP557, 2,136 amu; and fluconazole, 306 amu.
Isolates of C. krusei are intrinsically resistant to fluconazole (37).
Inhibition of planktonic growth was assessed using current CLSI methodology (37). Numbers in parenthesis indicate the number of strains with the MICs shown.

tables.label: TABLE 3
tables.caption: Susceptibility of dAMPs and fluconazole against planktonic yeasts, biofilm formation, and preformed biofilm for C. albicans isolate 17-88
footnotes: Lowest concentration with statistically significant inhibition.
Ratio of biofilm activity endpoint, statistically significant difference, to MIC.
